expert.name: Aiko
expert.role: Japan and Korea expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Eleven days with Hiroshima in the middle, which is the part most two country itineraries leave out.
expert.tip: Take the ferry to Miyajima late in the day. The gate at high tide with the light going is worth the wait.

summary: Eleven days across two countries: two nights by Seoul station with the demilitarised zone, three in Osaka with a walking tour and a Kyoto and Nara day, two in Hiroshima for the peace park and Miyajima, then three in Shinjuku with a city tour and Mount Fuji.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast; the flight from Seoul to Osaka and bullet trains in Japan; private airport transfers; a shared tour to the demilitarised zone; a guided walk through central Osaka; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with a buffet lunch; a guided day through the Hiroshima peace park with the ferry to Miyajima; a full day of guided sightseeing in Tokyo with lunch; the Mount Fuji fifth station and Lake Ashi, returning by bullet train.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan and Korea visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
